skills.name: Anthropic Skills
skills.author: anthropics
skills.description_en: The official Anthropic skills repo: document powerhouses (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf), skill-creator for authoring your own, mcp-builder, frontend-design, web-artifacts-builder, canvas-design and more — installable as a plugin marketplace.
skills.description_zh: Anthropic 官方技能仓库：文档四件套（Word/PPT/Excel/PDF）、自己写技能用的 skill-creator、mcp-builder、frontend-design、web-artifacts-builder、canvas-design 等，可作为插件市场一键安装。
skills.how_en: Install via the Claude Code plugin marketplace (anthropics/skills), or copy any skill folder into your skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 用 Claude Code 插件市场安装（anthropics/skills），或把任意技能文件夹复制进你的技能目录。

skills.name: Superpowers
skills.author: obra · Jesse Vincent
skills.description_en: Jesse Vincent's agentic skills framework and software development methodology: TDD, debugging, planning and collaboration skills that turn Claude Code into a disciplined engineer. The project that kicked off the skills boom.
skills.description_zh: Jesse Vincent 的智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论：TDD、调试、计划、协作等技能，把 Claude Code 变成守纪律的工程师——引爆整个技能生态的项目。
skills.how_en: Install as a Claude Code plugin from its marketplace (see README).
skills.how_zh: 作为 Claude Code 插件从其市场安装（见 README）。

skills.name: Agent-Reach
skills.author: Panniantong
skills.description_en: Give your agent eyes on the whole internet: read and search Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and more from one skill, with content delivered in a form agents can reason over.
skills.description_zh: 让你的智能体看见整个互联网：一个技能打通 Twitter/X、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站等平台的读取与搜索，把内容变成智能体能推理的形态。
skills.how_en: Follow the repo setup to connect platform credentials, then ask your agent to read or search any supported site.
skills.how_zh: 按仓库说明配置各平台凭据，然后直接让智能体去读或搜索目标平台。

skills.name: Graphify
skills.author: Graphify-Labs
skills.description_en: Turn any codebase — docs, SQL schemas, configs, PDFs — into a queryable knowledge graph via a /graphify skill, so agents can navigate large systems instead of guessing.
skills.description_zh: 用 /graphify 技能把任意代码库（文档、SQL schema、配置、PDF）变成可查询的知识图谱，让智能体真正看懂大型系统而不是靠猜。
skills.how_en: Install the /graphify skill, point it at a repository and query the generated graph.
skills.how_zh: 安装 /graphify 技能，指向代码库即可生成并查询知识图谱。

skills.name: Archify
skills.author: tt-a1i
skills.description_en: Turn any idea, plan or codebase into beautiful interactive diagrams. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and beyond — great for architecture docs and READMEs.
skills.description_zh: 把任何想法、计划或代码库变成精美的交互式图表——面向 Claude Code、Codex 等的智能体技能，写架构文档和 README 的利器。
skills.how_en: Copy the skill folder into your skills directory and ask your agent to archify a plan or repo.
skills.how_zh: 把技能文件夹复制进技能目录，让智能体 archify 你的计划或代码库。

skills.name: Awesome Claude Skills
skills.author: ComposioHQ
skills.description_en: One of the largest curated lists of Claude skills, resources and tools — the fastest way to survey the whole ecosystem from one README.
skills.description_zh: 规模最大的 Claude 技能精选列表之一：技能、资源、工具一站看全，是从一份 README 通览整个生态的最快方式。
skills.how_en: Browse the README and jump into any listed skill repo.
skills.how_zh: 浏览 README，点进任意技能仓库。

skills.name: Marketing Skills
skills.author: coreyhaines31
skills.description_en: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents: CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics and growth engineering — a full growth team in skill form.
skills.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 与 AI 智能体的营销技能包：CRO、文案、SEO、数据分析、增长工程——一套技能顶一个增长团队。
skills.how_en: Copy the skill folders you need into your skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 把需要的技能文件夹复制进技能目录。

skills.name: Academic Research Skills
skills.author: Imbad0202
skills.description_en: Academic research skills for Claude Code covering the full loop: research → write → review → revise → finalize. Built for literature-heavy, citation-disciplined work.
skills.description_zh: 覆盖学术研究全流程的 Claude Code 技能：检索 → 写作 → 评审 → 修改 → 定稿，为重文献、守引用规范的研究而生。
skills.how_en: Copy the skills into ~/.claude/skills/ and ask your agent to run the research pipeline.
skills.how_zh: 把技能复制进 ~/.claude/skills/，让智能体按流程跑研究管线。

skills.name: Scientific Agent Skills
skills.author: K-Dense-AI
skills.description_en: Turn any AI agent into an AI scientist: the top skills library for science — literature review, bioinformatics, analysis pipelines — used by 250,000+ researchers.
skills.description_zh: 把任意智能体变成 AI 科学家：科学领域第一大技能库，覆盖文献综述、生物信息、分析管线，超过 25 万科研人员在用。
skills.how_en: Install the collection and invoke domain skills (e.g. literature review, protein analysis) per task.
skills.how_zh: 安装合集后按任务调用领域技能（文献综述、蛋白分析等）。

skills.name: Cybersecurity Skill Pack
skills.author: mukul975
skills.description_en: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents, mapped to 6 frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0 — defensive coverage you can audit.
skills.description_zh: 817 个结构化网络安全技能，映射到 MITRE ATT&CK、NIST CSF 2.0 等 6 大框架——可审计的防御知识库。
skills.how_en: Copy the framework-aligned skill folders you need into your skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 把所需框架对应的技能文件夹复制进技能目录。

skills.name: Book to Skill
skills.author: virgiliojr94
skills.description_en: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference and use while you work. Books stop gathering dust.
skills.description_zh: 把任何技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能——边工作边随时调用、随时查阅，让买过的书不再吃灰。
skills.how_en: Feed it a book PDF; it generates a study-ready skill folder.
skills.how_zh: 喂给它一本书的 PDF，自动生成可学习的技能文件夹。

skills.name: Hallmark
skills.author: Nutlope
skills.description_en: An anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex: opinionated design taste so generated UI stops looking generated.
skills.description_zh: 面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 的反 AI 味设计技能：内置主见的设计品味，让生成的 UI 不再一眼假。
skills.how_en: Add the skill to your agent's skills directory; design rules apply to every UI task.
skills.how_zh: 把技能加入智能体技能目录，之后所有 UI 任务自动带上设计规则。

skills.name: Cloudflare Security Audit
skills.author: cloudflare
skills.description_en: Cloudflare's official coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits, with independently verified, machine-readable findings.
skills.description_zh: Cloudflare 官方的编码智能体安全审计技能：多阶段审计，产出可独立验证、机器可读的结果。
skills.how_en: Install the skill, then ask your agent to audit a repo or diff.
skills.how_zh: 安装技能后，让智能体对仓库或 diff 做安全审计。

skills.name: Claude Code Game Studios
skills.author: Donchitos
skills.description_en: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio: 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills and a complete coordination system for shipping games.
skills.description_zh: 把 Claude Code 变成完整的游戏工作室：49 个 AI 智能体、72 个工作流技能和一整套协作调度系统。
skills.how_en: Install the collection and assign studio roles (design, code, art, QA) to your agent.
skills.how_zh: 安装合集后，给智能体分配工作室角色（策划/程序/美术/QA）。

skills.name: Planning with Files
skills.author: OthmanAdi
skills.description_en: Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: crash-proof markdown plans, session memory and long-running task state that survives restarts.
skills.description_zh: 面向 AI 编码智能体的持久化文件规划：防崩溃的 markdown 计划、会话记忆与长任务状态，重启也不丢。
skills.how_en: Copy into your skills directory; plans live in markdown files next to your code.
skills.how_zh: 复制进技能目录；计划以 markdown 文件形式与代码同库存放。

skills.name: Claude Skills Mega-Pack
skills.author: alirezarezvani
skills.description_en: A mega-pack of 380 Claude Code skills plus 30+ agents and 70+ custom commands — breadth first, ideal for assembling your own toolkit.
skills.description_zh: 380 个 Claude Code 技能 + 30 多个 agent + 70 多个自定义命令的超大合集——广度优先，适合自己攒工具箱。
skills.how_en: Browse categories and copy the skills you want into your skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 按分类浏览，把想要的技能复制进技能目录。

skills.name: Huashu Design
skills.author: alchaincyf · 花叔
skills.description_en: Huashu's HTML-native design skill for Claude Code: high-fidelity prototypes, slides and animation pages generated as pure HTML — a community favorite for beautiful output.
skills.description_zh: 花叔的 Claude Code HTML 原生设计技能：高保真原型、幻灯片、动效页直接产出纯 HTML——社区公认的高颜值输出。
skills.how_en: Copy into ~/.claude/skills/ and ask for prototypes, slides or poster pages in HTML.
skills.how_zh: 复制进 ~/.claude/skills/，直接要求产出 HTML 原型、幻灯片或海报页。

skills.name: Khazix Skills
skills.author: KKKKhazix · 数字生命卡兹克
skills.description_en: Khazix's open-source AI skills collection: leader (goal definition), neat-freak, hv-analysis, khazix-writer and more — practical Chinese-community favorites.
skills.description_zh: 数字生命卡兹克开源的 AI 技能合集：leader（帮你定义目标）、neat-freak 洁癖、hv-analysis、khazix-writer 等，中文圈实测好用的口碑之作。
skills.how_en: Copy the skills you want into your skills directory (README in Chinese).
skills.how_zh: 把想要的技能复制进技能目录（README 为中文）。

skills.name: NotebookLM Py
skills.author: teng-lin
skills.description_en: Unofficial Python API and agentic skill for Google NotebookLM: full programmatic access to notebooks, sources and generated content.
skills.description_zh: Google NotebookLM 的非官方 Python API 与智能体技能：笔记本、来源与生成内容全量可编程操控。
skills.how_en: pip install the package, then use the bundled agent skill to drive NotebookLM.
skills.how_zh: pip 安装后，用附带的智能体技能驱动 NotebookLM。

skills.name: SkillSpector
skills.author: NVIDIA
skills.description_en: NVIDIA's security scanner for AI agent skills: detects vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, prompt injection and risky code before you install a SKILL.md.
skills.description_zh: NVIDIA 出品的技能安全扫描器：在安装任何 SKILL.md 之前，检出漏洞、恶意模式、提示词注入与危险代码。
skills.how_en: Run SkillSpector against any skill folder or collection before installing it.
skills.how_zh: 安装前对任意技能文件夹或合集跑一遍 SkillSpector。

skills.name: Humanizer-zh
skills.author: op7418 · 歸藏
skills.description_en: Guizang's Chinese edition of Humanizer, the Claude Code skill that strips AI-generated traces from text — rhythm, vocabulary and structure all de-slopped.
skills.description_zh: 歸藏汉化的 Humanizer：Claude Code 技能，专治文本里的 AI 味——从节奏、用词到结构逐层去机器感。
skills.how_en: Copy into ~/.claude/skills/, then ask your agent to humanize a draft.
skills.how_zh: 复制进 ~/.claude/skills/，让智能体 humanize 你的稿子。

skills.name: Claude SEO
skills.author: AgriciDaniel
skills.description_en: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code: 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema and content optimization.
skills.description_zh: 通用 SEO 技能：26 个子技能 + 19 个子 agent，覆盖技术 SEO、E-E-A-T、结构化数据与内容优化。
skills.how_en: Install the skill pack and ask for audits, keyword plans or schema markup.
skills.how_zh: 安装技能包后，直接要求站点审计、关键词规划或 schema 标记。

skills.name: SkillOpt
skills.author: microsoft · MSR
skills.description_en: Microsoft Research's text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents — the science of making skills better.
skills.description_zh: 微软研究院的文本空间优化器：为冻结参数的 LLM 智能体训练可复用的自然语言技能——把「技能怎么变强」变成科学。
skills.how_en: Research toolkit: clone, prepare your task set and optimize skills per the repo guide.
skills.how_zh: 研究工具箱：克隆仓库，按指南准备任务集并优化技能。

skills.name: ARIS Research
skills.author: wanshuiyin
skills.description_en: ARIS (Auto-Research-In-Sleep): markdown-only skills for autonomous ML research — cross-model review and experiment loops that run while you sleep.
skills.description_zh: ARIS（睡着也能做科研）：纯 markdown 的自主科研技能——跨模型评审与实验循环，睡前挂机、醒来看结果。
skills.how_en: Install the ARIS skills and launch an overnight research loop.
skills.how_zh: 安装 ARIS 技能后，启动过夜科研循环。

skills.name: Awesome Claude Skills · travisvn
skills.author: travisvn
skills.description_en: A well-maintained curated list of awesome Claude skills, resources and tools with clear category navigation.
skills.description_zh: 维护良好的 Claude 技能精选列表：分类清晰、收录讲究的技能/资源/工具导航。
skills.how_en: Browse the README by category and follow links out to each skill.
skills.how_zh: 按分类浏览 README，点进具体技能。

skills.name: Skill Seekers
skills.author: yusufkaraaslan
skills.description_en: Convert documentation sites, GitHub repos and PDFs into Claude-ready skills automatically, with conflict detection when merging sources.
skills.description_zh: 把文档站、GitHub 仓库和 PDF 自动转成 Claude 技能，合并多来源时还能自动检测冲突。
skills.how_en: Run the converter against a docs URL, repo or PDF to emit a skill folder.
skills.how_zh: 对文档 URL、仓库或 PDF 跑转换脚本，产出技能文件夹。

skills.name: Prompt Master
skills.author: nidhinjs
skills.description_en: A skill that writes accurate prompts for any AI tool — full context assembly with zero tokens wasted on guesswork.
skills.description_zh: 帮任何 AI 工具写准提示词的技能：完整上下文组装，不浪费一个 token 在瞎猜上。
skills.how_en: Install the skill and ask it to draft or fix a prompt.
skills.how_zh: 安装技能后，让它起草或修复你的提示词。

skills.name: AI Guide · 程序员鱼皮
skills.author: liyupi
skills.description_en: Yupi's AI resource compendium plus zero-basics vibe coding tutorials: model playbooks, OpenClaw walkthroughs and skills guidance for Chinese developers.
skills.description_zh: 程序员鱼皮的 AI 资源大全 + Vibe Coding 零基础教程：大模型玩法、OpenClaw 保姆级教程与技能使用指南，中文开发者友好。
skills.how_en: Read the guide; follow its curated links into tools and skills.
skills.how_zh: 直接阅读指南，按其精选链接进入各工具与技能。

skills.name: Microsoft Skills
skills.author: microsoft
skills.description_en: Microsoft's official skills, MCP servers, custom agents and AGENTS.md templates for grounding coding agents across their SDKs and developer stack.
skills.description_zh: 微软官方出品：技能、MCP 服务器、自定义 agent 与 AGENTS.md 模板，为其 SDK 与开发者工具链的编码智能体提供接地能力。
skills.how_en: Browse the catalog and follow per-skill install instructions.
skills.how_zh: 浏览目录，按各技能说明安装。

skills.name: SwiftUI Expert Skill
skills.author: AvdLee
skills.description_en: Expert SwiftUI best-practices guidance in the open Agent Skills format — keeping generated Swift code production-grade.
skills.description_zh: 以开放 Agent Skills 格式提供的 SwiftUI 专家级最佳实践——让生成的 Swift 代码达到生产级水准。
skills.how_en: Copy the swiftui-expert-skill folder into your agent's skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 把 swiftui-expert-skill 文件夹复制进智能体技能目录。

skills.name: Awesome Design Skills
skills.author: bergside
skills.description_en: 67 curated DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design files for agentic tools — aesthetic families you can mix into any UI project.
skills.description_zh: 67 个精选 DESIGN.md / SKILL.md 设计文件——按美学族系归类，可混搭进任何 UI 项目。
skills.how_en: Pick a design file and drop it into your project as a skill or design context.
skills.how_zh: 挑一个设计文件，作为技能或设计上下文放进项目。

skills.name: Sepia
skills.author: Nanako0129
skills.description_en: De-AI writing skill compatible with 77+ Agent Skills agents (native plugins for Claude and more): repairs narrative structure and humanizes prose.
skills.description_zh: 兼容 77+ 智能体的去 AI 味写作技能（Claude 等有原生插件）：修复叙事结构，让文字读起来像人写的。
skills.how_en: Install via its CLI or copy the skill folder; works across many agents.
skills.how_zh: 用其 CLI 安装或直接复制技能文件夹，多智能体通用。

skills.name: Angular Skills
skills.author: angular
skills.description_en: The Angular team's official agent skills — framework-accurate guidance for building and modernizing Angular apps with coding agents.
skills.description_zh: Angular 团队官方智能体技能——用编码智能体开发/升级 Angular 应用时，给出与框架精确对齐的指导。
skills.how_en: Follow the repo instructions to add angular-developer and angular-new-app skills.
skills.how_zh: 按仓库说明安装 angular-developer 与 angular-new-app 技能。

skills.name: Frontend Design Toolkit
skills.author: wilwaldon
skills.description_en: A battle-tested bundle of skills, plugins and MCP servers that measurably improve Claude Code's frontend output.
skills.description_zh: 经过实战检验的技能/插件/MCP 组合包，实打实提升 Claude Code 的前端产出质量。
skills.how_en: Install components à la carte per the README.
skills.how_zh: 按 README 挑选需要的组件安装。

skills.name: Awesome Claude Design
skills.author: rohitg00
skills.description_en: DESIGN.md prompt packs organized by aesthetic family, plus remix recipes, skills and video teardowns for design-minded agent work.
skills.description_zh: 按美学族系组织的 DESIGN.md 提示词包，附混搭配方、技能与视频拆解，面向有设计追求的智能体工作流。
skills.how_en: Copy a DESIGN.md aesthetic into your project or install the accompanying skills.
skills.how_zh: 把心仪的 DESIGN.md 美学复制进项目，或安装随附技能。

skills.name: Gamedev Agent Skills
skills.author: gamedev-skills
skills.description_en: 74 game-dev skills for AI coding agents: Godot, Unity, Unreal, Phaser, PixiJS, three.js, Bevy, pygame, LÖVE and more.
skills.description_zh: 74 个游戏开发技能：Godot、Unity、Unreal、Phaser、PixiJS、three.js、Bevy、pygame、LÖVE 等引擎全覆盖。
skills.how_en: Copy the engine-specific skills you need into your skills directory.
skills.how_zh: 把对应引擎的技能复制进技能目录。

skills.name: Self-Learning Skills
skills.author: Kulaxyz
skills.description_en: A self-improving skill: recognize hard-won golden paths while coding and persist them as reusable skills for the next run.
skills.description_zh: 会自我进化的技能：编码中识别来之不易的黄金路径，沉淀成可复用技能，越用越顺手。
skills.how_en: Install the skill; it captures lessons automatically as you work.
skills.how_zh: 安装后它会随你的工作自动沉淀经验。

skills.name: Video Spec Builder
skills.author: feicaiclub
skills.description_en: Turns 'I want a video' into a second-precise storyboard spec (video-spec.md) for HyperFrames to render — one command installs it into Claude Code / Cursor / Codex.
skills.description_zh: 把「我想做个视频」逼成精确到秒的分镜脚本 video-spec.md，交给 HyperFrames 渲染——一条命令装进 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex。
skills.how_en: One-line install command from the README, then describe the video you want.
skills.how_zh: README 里一行命令安装，然后直接描述你想要的视频。

skills.name: Huashu md↔html
skills.author: alchaincyf · 花叔
skills.description_en: Huashu's bidirectional md/html pipeline: anything → markdown, markdown → beautiful HTML, HTML → markdown — wrapping markitdown, Pandoc and html-to-markdown.
skills.description_zh: 花叔的 md/html 双向流水线：万物→md、md→精美 HTML、HTML→md 一站式，封装 markitdown、Pandoc 与 html-to-markdown。
skills.how_en: Install the skill and ask for format conversions in conversation.
skills.how_zh: 安装技能后，对话里直接要求格式转换。

skills.name: LambdaTest Agent Skills
skills.author: LambdaTest
skills.description_en: LambdaTest's official collection of 50+ testing skills: Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, pytest, Jest and more, wired to their cloud test platform.
skills.description_zh: LambdaTest 官方 50+ 测试技能合集：Playwright、Selenium、Cypress、Appium、pytest、Jest 等，直连其云测试平台。
skills.how_en: Pick framework skills from the repo and follow per-skill setup.
skills.how_zh: 从仓库挑选框架技能，按各自说明接入。

skills.name: Courier Notifications
skills.author: trycourier
skills.description_en: Courier's official skill for building production-ready notifications across email, SMS, push, in-app, Slack and Teams.
skills.description_zh: Courier 官方技能：构建覆盖邮件、短信、推送、应用内、Slack 与 Teams 的生产级通知系统。
skills.how_en: Install the skill and describe the notification flow you need.
skills.how_zh: 安装技能后，直接描述你要的通知流程。

skills.name: Charlie CFO Skill
skills.author: EveryInc
